messages:
OPS-Bot: ALERT: increased 5xxs and long tail latency on /v1/generate in us-west-2. Severity: P1. Trigger: 5xx > 5% for 5m and p95 > 1.2s. Pager routed to @OnCall-SRE. War room: https://warroom.redwood.ai/rooms/INC-2222222222
OPS-Bot: Incident channel created and recording started.

OnCall-SRE: Acknowledged. Joining war room. Assigning owner now.
OnCall-SRE: Owner: Kai M (runtime). Kai, please lead triage and mitigation.

Kai M: taking owner. joining war room. quick triage plan: 1) confirm service error signatures, 2) check recent deploys and traffic shifts, 3) inspect worker+model-host connectivity and KV cache.

DeployBot: Noted recent deploy: redwood/rt:v2.8.4 rolled at 2026-03-15T10:05:11Z by @eng-release. Canary 15% started at 10:05:20Z.

Leah D: infra checking autoscaler and pool health. Seeing a scale-up delay and a handful of nodes in pool reporting 'NotReady' starting ~10:07 UTC. Opening quota check.

QuotaBot: Soft quota reached on gpu-pool in us-west-2. Autorequest queued: #INC-QUOTA-3221 (ETA 12m).

Kai M: running quick commands: `kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=redwood-rt -o wide` and `kubectl -n inference logs -l app=redwood-rt --since=10m | grep -i "502\|503\|timeout\|connection reset"`

Kai M: Observed worker logs with repeated "upstream connection timeout" and intermittent 504s. Also seeing redis connection errors interleaved.

Leah D: LB healthchecks show some backend nodes failing around 10:06-10:09. Suspect burst of requests + slow model-host responses. Model-host team pinged.

Model-host team (via war room): we see GC pauses on a subset of hosts; collecting heap dumps. Restart plan ready if necessary.

OnCall-SRE: Mitigation plan agreed: 1) cordon + restart suspect worker pods (Kai), 2) temporarily shift 25% traffic to us-east-1 (Leah), 3) raise redis maxclients and enable slowlog sampling (OpsComms will coordinate with infra).

Kai M: Starting rolling restarts of highest-restart workers in small batches: `kubectl -n inference drain rt-worker-21 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` then `kubectl -n inference delete pod rt-worker-21` — proceeding carefully to avoid capacity cliffs.

Leah D: Applying LB weight change: us-west-2 -> 75%, us-east-1 -> 25%. Monitoring impact on error rates and p95.

OpsComms: I'll prepare a concise status page blurb and a customer DM draft for SLA customers. Pasting both here for quick review.

Kai M: After first restart batch + weight change, error rate dropped from 6.2% -> 1.7% in 4m. p95 decreased from 1.5s -> 0.95s. Looks promising.

OpsComms: Status page draft (short):
```
We are investigating elevated errors and increased latency for the text-generation API in us-west-2. Engineers have restarted worker processes and temporarily redistributed traffic to reduce pressure on the fleet. Error rates are decreasing and we will provide updates every 15 minutes.
```

OpsComms: Customer DM template (SLA customers):
```
Hi <CustomerName>,
We are investigating intermittent 5xx errors and higher latency affecting text-generation in us-west-2. Engineers have implemented mitigations (restarted worker pods and temporarily redistributed traffic) and error rates are improving. We will send a full incident report and timeline by EOD. For urgent concerns please reply or contact support@redwood.ai.
```

SupportBot: Notifying support channel and queuing targeted DMs for top SLA accounts once OpsComms gives approval.

Kai M: Uploading logs, Grafana snapshots, and commands to war room under /artifacts/INC-2222222222. Will include `kubectl` commands used, timestamps, and quick notes for RCA.

Leah D: QuotaBot returned: temporary burst quota approved; spinning up 3 burst GPU nodes in us-west-2 to alleviate pressure. ETA ~6m for readiness.

Kai M: After additional restarts and burst nodes coming online, error rate holding ~0.7% over 10m. No customer data loss observed.

OnCall-SRE: Good progress. Action items: Kai continue monitoring and validate model-host health; Leah continue quota/burst nodes and plan revert for LB weights; OpsComms finalize status page and customer DMs; SupportBot monitor and escalate any customer replies. If stable for 30m, consider downgrading severity P1->P2 and start RCA. Handoff window available in 3h.

OpsComms: Posting status page update now. Will send targeted DMs after confirming the current 3m snapshot.

SupportBot: DMs to top SLA customers queued and ready to send on OpsComms approval.

Kai M: Observed a subtle correlation: older canary instances intermittently create longer model-host connections likely due to a library version mismatch. Not triggering rollback yet; collecting exact stack traces and timestamps.

DeployBot: Canary fraction currently 15% (redwood/rt:v2.8.4). No automatic rollback triggered.

OnCall-SRE: If the canary is implicated, we will rollback the canary. For now prefer mitigation via restarts and traffic steering to avoid broad impact. Keep this thread as single source of truth.

Leah D: Burst nodes are registered and draining pressure; planning to revert LB weights to 90/10 in 10m if p95 < 1s and 5xx < 1% sustained.

Kai M: Confirming stable for 20m. Error rate ~0.5%, p95 ~0.82s. Preparing concise timeline and list of artifacts for postmortem.

OnCall-SRE: Great. Keep updates minimal unless new regressions. If stable for 30m, reduce severity and schedule RCA owner. Handoff ETA: 3h.

OPS-Bot: Reminder: automated next update in 15 minutes.

OpsComms: Finalizing customer DM sends; will paste copy of sent messages to war room.

SupportBot: DMs dispatched to top SLA customers; copying sends into war room channel.

Kai M: Logging out of war room for now but will stay on call if alerted. Uploaded heap dumps and GC traces for model-host team.

OnCall-SRE: Thanks team. Keep thread concise. Any follow-up action items (RCA, capacity requests) create tickets and link them here.

OPS-Bot: INCIDENT UPDATE posted to war room and status page.
